competences.description: Attacks the enemy to transfer 1 harmful effect granted on yourself to the enemy. Increases your Attack Bar by 10% if there are no harmful effects to transfer.

effets.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If there are no harmful effects to transfer

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to stun for 1 turn. Afterwards, you are guaranteed to be stunned for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Recovers the HP of all allies by 20% when you gain a turn under an inability effect. In addition, increases the damage that allies deal to enemies by 20% while you are under an inability effect. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: When you gain a turn under an inability effect
On allies while you are under an inability effect
